units: B. Kam. 67ᵃ דמעיקרא ק׳ וכ׳ Ms. R. (ed. קְצִיצְתָּא; Ms. H. קְצַצְ׳) before (it was made a trough) it was called plank, and now tsinnora.—Pl. קְצוּצְיָיתָה, קְצוּצְיָיתָא.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 96a:9">Ib. 96ᵃ</cite> stolen beams <he>עבדינהו קצ׳</he> (Ms. R. <cite ref="S01799"><he>קְצוּצָתָא</he></cite>; Ms. H. <he>קְצַצְיָיתָא</he>) which he cut into planks.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79">Gen. R. s. 79</cite> <he>הוה מקצץ … ושדי קְצוּצְוָתֵיה וכ׳</he> (‘Rashi’, <he>קְצִיצָתֵיה</he>; Matt. K. <he>קְצוּצָתֵיה</he>) he cut a lupine and threw its slices about &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 133:27">Yalk. ib. 133</cite> <he>והוה קצרן … קִיצּוּצְוָתֵיה</he> (corr. acc.)
